en: The postcard features several images of a traditional-looking building, possibly a former monastery, and scenes from a restaurant with outdoor and indoor seating. The tables are covered with colorful, traditional cloths, and people are seen dining, attended by waitstaff. There is Cyrillic text that reads 'Манастирска изба' (Monastery Tavern/Inn). The reverse side contains information in Bulgarian, Russian, and French describing the restaurant 'Manastirska Izba'. There's also a library stamp from Varna and other Bulgarian text.
